body: Use the uploaded portrait to create a sophisticated fashion-cover photograph. Preserve the person's identity. Style them in an architectural black jacket against a warm gray seamless studio backdrop. One large softbox from the left, subtle edge light, natural skin texture, restrained makeup and a direct confident gaze. Waist-up composition with generous empty space above the head for a magazine title and clear margins for later typesetting. Minimal editorial styling, muted colors, vertical 4:5. Do not invent typography or brand names.
